initial_history: Latest 90 full-2022 validation days with labels released before the first 2023 issue. Seed thresholds are fitted before 2023 starts. No 2023 future labels enter issue state.
feedback_clock: Target day plus one day at 09:00 UTC
issue_clock: Target day minus one day at 09:30 UTC
ncc_application_adaptations: Six deterministic target-calendar features as auxiliary context
Truncated daily training using recomputed issued-input snapshots when feedback matures
Bounded 32-step TTA with explicit deterministic nesting repair
selection_rule: Require each marginal validation coverage within three percentage points. NCC must additionally improve weighted interval score by at least 5% against the best eligible residual method. Otherwise keep NCC experimental. If no method meets coverage gates, retain lowest-score residual candidate with failed gate explicitly reported.
